title: Original multi-control Styles with Amount, descriptions and search
source: rapidroom (original native preset recipes and integration)
notes: Adds twenty original colour looks using luma and RGB channel curves, selective HSL, calibration, grading and restrained finishing. The twenty Styles start as a flat list without built-in folders and replace the old stock pack once in fresh and existing libraries; user/imported items and favourite, edited, moved or renamed stock remain, with stable IDs preserving favourites and moved presets and a migration marker preserving user deletions. Descriptions are retained and searchable. Amount respects partial hue-only grading presets, fades neutral wheels without hue rotation and follows the shortest arc between coloured wheels. Dark Forest adds an editable, image-relative warm beam that preserves existing masks and fades with Amount. Default renders are unchanged by style application code; applied styles and grading Amount behaviour change intentionally. All twenty looks have owner taste acceptance; fresh native validation passes all 23 checks, all 60 default-render comparisons are pixel-identical, and public CC0 before/after evidence is recorded in rapidroom/validation/styles-308.
